newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. 21,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,900 formulated and 400 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was $66.00 per cwt on Friday.
Tuesday's packer bids were $65.00-$66.00, with asking prices at $68.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
